<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈124–136 ppm) are: 135.43 (×2), 130.70 (×2), 130.40 (×2), 128.70 (×2), 128.35 (×2), 124.85 (×2). Each appears twice, indicating two equivalent carbons for each environment. Thus the total number of aromatic carbon atoms is 6 × 2 = 12.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
